name: Adam Scott Foundation Scholarship
summary: Pays all student contribution charges for Australian citizens starting a Griffith business degree.
key: Payment of 100% of the student contribution charges (CSP/HECS).
who: Accepted into a Griffith undergraduate business degree starting in Trimester 1 of the year of award.
Not previously completed a bachelor's degree or higher.
how: Apply through Griffith's online scholarship application process.
Two referees, two personal statements and a CV; shortlisted applicants are interviewed.

source.label: Griffith University: Adam Scott Foundation Scholarship

evidence.quote: This scholarship is for payment of 100% of the student contribution charges (CSP/HECS).
